value.reason: Ticket describes a possible incident (status page degradation, core feature unusable) but is missing details needed for escalation per the incident escalation policy.

groundedReply.suggestedResponse: Thanks for reporting this. Because you're seeing a status page degradation alongside your team's inability to use the main feature, this may need to be escalated as a possible incident. To help us assess and escalate this properly, could you provide: (1) the time you first noticed the issue, (2) the region your team is in, (3) which specific feature is affected, and (4) a brief description of the symptom you're experiencing? Once we have these details, we can move forward with the appropriate escalation.

citations.claim: Escalate when the status page reports degradation or a core function fails for multiple users, and record the first observed time, affected region, feature, and a concise symptom.
